# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.

completion:
Document the exact dates and times of the excessive emissions.
3. Record the exact type of emissions (e.g., VOCs, NOx, SO2, particulate matter).
4. Take measurements of emission levels and compare them with permissible standards.
5. Detail the method of measurement (e.g., continuous emission monitoring systems, portable emission monitors, manual sampling).
6. Document all available data on meteorological conditions during the period of excessive emissions (e.g., wind speed, wind direction, temperature, humidity).
7. Include any relevant observations (e.g., visible plumes, odors, community complaints).
8. Note any operational conditions or equipment malfunctions during the period (e.g., start-up, shutdown, maintenance).
9. Review and attach all related monitoring reports, logs, and correspondence related to the emissions.
